subject: Action required: apply manual adjustment to ledger + PO and VAT routing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: accounts-payable@acme.com, susan.lloyd@acme.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Manual adjustment request + PO for June invoice overbilling

Hi Susan / AP team,

Thanks again for flagging the discrepancy on your June usage invoice. Our preliminary analysis shows a duplicate reserved-capacity charge of $9,430 that should not have been billed — appears to have been counted twice during the scheduled scaling window on 2026-06-01.

Attached is the purchase order you referenced (PO-8347) and Acme's VAT certificate you sent last week. To keep your ledger clean, we'd like to apply a manual adjustment in one of two ways — please confirm which you prefer:

1) Issue a credit memo for $9,430 and apply it to your next invoice (recommended), or
2) Apply a provisional ledger adjustment now and include a formal credit memo on the amended invoice after tax evidence is validated.

Operational ask: if you confirm option (2), we need the PO number to be linked to the ledger entry so your AP system can reconcile (we'll set GL code 6123). If you prefer option (1), we'll prepare the credit memo and route VAT evidence to our EU tax team so the credit has the correct tax treatment.

Proposed timeline: we can prepare a provisional adjustment by EOD Thu 21-May and issue the final credit memo once tax evidence is validated (usually 3-5 business days).

Please reply with: (A) preferred remediation approach, (B) confirmation of PO number to apply (if different from attached), and (C) whether Acme needs us to send a formal invoice amendment (we can send via DocuSign).

Thanks — want to get this closed before month-end so your finance team isn't blocked.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: PO-ACME-8347.pdf (application/pdf), acme_vat_certificate_2026.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Susan Lloyd <susan.lloyd@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@acme.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Manual adjustment request + PO for June invoice overbilling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Apologies for the noise on our side — we did see the duplicate line when reconciling. Acme prefers option (1): please issue a credit memo for $9,430 and apply it to the next invoice.

PO is confirmed as PO-8347 (same as attached). Our AP team also needs the credit memo to include our VAT registration number and a short explanation "duplicate reserved-capacity charge" to match our internal workflow.

If you can send the amended invoice and credit memo via DocuSign (or a signed PDF), that would be ideal. Timeline: we need the documentation before 31-May for our month-end close.

Susan Lloyd
Director, Treasury Operations
Acme Corp
susan.lloyd@acme.com

Subject: RE: Manual adjustment request + PO for June invoice overbilling

Marissa / Ben / Tessa,

Thanks — keeping this tight for Acme's month-end. Per Susan, we'll proceed with option (1): generate a credit memo for $9,430 and apply it to the next invoice. Operational notes for billing ops (Tessa):

- Create Credit Memo CM-2026-ACME-0923 for $9,430 and link to PO-8347.
- Apply GL code 6123 (Reserved capacity adjustments).
- Include Acme VAT reg: GB123456789 in the memo and note "duplicate reserved-capacity charge" in the memo narrative.
- Tax treatment: route the supporting VAT certificate to EU tax team and mark the memo as VAT-adjusted. If tax team requires additional proof, hold the credit in escrow and release on validation (expected 3 business days).
- Delivery: export signed PDF and upload to Drive folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2Bacme-ledger-evidence) and send DocuSign to Acme (accounts-payable@acme.com).

Ben — one ask: Acme mentions month-end timing. Do you approve a small goodwill concession if tax validation pushes beyond 3 working days? We can front a provisional credit and sweep any reversal if validation fails, but that requires sales sign-off for exposure up to $9.4k.

Marissa — once Tessa confirms the CM is ready, please notify the AP contact and copy Rishi.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: internal_credit_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks,
